Lower Text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)
Upper Text: [Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

Trash all digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return all cards in your or your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck. If this effect returned level 7 white cards, gain 3 memory.
[When Attacking] By returning 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, unsuspend this Digimon.
